top_signals.title: ‘Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?’: The comedy and horror of being forgotten
top_signals.summary: "Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?" is a genuinely funny, uplifting and heartwarming watch — if you can get over its slightly problematic premise.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
